notes: This is the exact greenwashing the brief exists to attack. 'Eco-friendly', 'run green', 'planet-first' and a dateless 'carbon-neutral by 2030' are unverifiable adjective claims — our audience treats every one of them as a red flag. Rebuild the strategy around proof: verifiable numbers, published audits, receipts. The enemy is not carbon, it is unsubstantiated claims. Position us as the brand that shows its work.
